report_summary: The expanded report offers concrete technical recipes and repeated reminders that a stored URL or exploit input is not proof of execution. It strengthens the coordinated-behavior account and preserves actor alternatives; its principal remaining overreach is presenting moderation as the cause of migration and immediate adaptive rewriting.

outside_scope_leads: Exact duplicate-body frequencies, host counts, peak five-minute totals and a statement describing 73 repeated targets rather than excess deletion events are not independently resolved here.
